'''K-OHN''' (or '''KONE''') was a [[Manumission|manumitted]] [[L-1g general purpose droid|L-1 tactical droid]] that provided people with his programmed skills in exchange for energy and [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. K-OHN's personal goal was to gather enough funds to obtain a processor upgrade that would allow him to comprehend the idea of spirituality, but he also shared part his earnings with a band of street urchins he once befriended.<ref name="RO VG" /> K-OHN was present in [[Jedha City]] shortly before the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] it<ref name="Rogue One" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> He was equipped with an [[AA-1 VerboBrain|AA-1]] [[Verbobrain|VerboBrain]].<ref name="RO VG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:K-OHN concept art Hidalgo tweet.png|thumb|Concept art of the droid that would become K-OHN on Eadu by Adam Brockbank.|left|277x277px]]
{{Quote|This droid began life as a L-1 series tactical droid that was originally intended to accompany a rebel strike force to Eadu in an earlier iteration of the story. Art by Adam Brockbank. It instead ended up on Jedha, and I named him K-0HN.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="Hidalgo tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1701730918975909964|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=This droid began life as a L-1 series tactical droid that was originally intended to accompany a rebel strike force to Eadu in an earlier iteration of the story. Art by Adam Brockbank. It instead ended up on Jedha, and I named him K-0HN.|date=2023-09-13|archivedate=20230917213955}}</ref>}}
K-OHN first appeared in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> where he was portrayed by [[Dee Tails]].<ref name="DTtweet">{{Twitter|deetails|status/817451699946323969|[[Dee Tails]]|date=2017-01-06|quote=This is the L-1 Droid I get to play in Rogue One.|archivedate=20200812140445}}</ref> He was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="RO VG" /> The droid that would become K-OHN was originally intended to accompany the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Alliance]] team to the [[mission to Eadu]] in the film and concept art was done by [[Adam Brockbank]], but he was ultimately scrapped from the scenes and was instead repurposed as one of the many individuals in the scenes in Jedha City.<ref name="Hidalgo tweet" />
